decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Cascade to quickly deploy powerful spells and creatures onto the battlefield, overwhelming your opponent with aggression. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea, you can cascade into high-impact spells like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Thundering Falls. Leyline Binding and Force of Negation help you control the board while Misty Rainforest and Flooded Strand provide mana fixing. By combining aggressive creatures with cascading spells, you can create a fast-paced and unpredictable playstyle that keeps your opponent on their toes.

The main focus of this Mardu Aggro deck is to quickly deploy and buff up creatures, using cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride, to pressure the opponent and deal damage efficiently. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional reach and damage potential. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistent casting of its spells and creatures, allowing for a fast and aggressive gameplay style.

This deck focuses on assembling a wide variety of creatures through tutoring effects like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith. By using powerful combo pieces like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, as well as toolbox creatures like Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons and Endurance, the deck can adapt to various situations and outvalue opponents. The deck also features utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Underground Mortuary to support the creature-based game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a versatile and synergistic creature toolbox.

The main idea of this Mono Black Control deck is to use a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's resources, while also utilizing board wipes like Damnation and March of Wretched Sorrow to maintain board presence. The deck also aims to utilize graveyard recursion through cards like Cling to Dust and Necrodominance to outvalue the opponent. Lastly, it aims to finish off the opponent with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and efficient removal spells like Fatal Push.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and card advantage. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal, while also drawing cards and generating value with cards like Thought Scour and Cling to Dust, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through incremental advantage. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters allows the deck to close out the game once it has gained control.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing creatures and using them to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It also includes cards that can disrupt the opponent's strategy, such as Thoughtseize and Static Prison. The deck has a good mix of low-to-the-ground creatures, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. It has a strong mana base to support its aggressive strategy and can provide reach with cards like Goblin Bombardment. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with threats and efficient spells to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the Splinter Twin combo with Deceiver Exarch to create an infinite loop of hasty token creatures. It includes disruption and protection spells like Teferi, Time Raveler, Spell Pierce, Spell Snare, and Force of Negation to help the combo go off smoothly. The deck also features removal spells like Unholy Heat, Lightning Bolt, and Prismatic Ending to control the board and buy time to set up the combo. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides card advantage and mana ramp, while Preordain helps with card selection. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with an army of token creatures.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be tutored for using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Chord of Calling, enabling the player to adapt to different situations and combos. It also includes disruption in the form of removal spells like Fatal Push and Malevolent Rumble. The key strategy is to use Grist, the Hunger Tide, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and other synergistic creatures to generate value and overwhelm the opponent with a variety of threats. The land base supports the toolbox strategy by providing access to different colors and utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures.

The main idea of this deck is to use a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Negation and Spell Snare, along with removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to survive long enough to play powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Thought Scour and Consider to dig for answers and maintain card advantage. It focuses on controlling the game and outlasting the opponent in a battle of attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Street Wraith, Faithless Looting, and Burning Inquiry to enable cheap or free casts of powerful threats like Hollow One and Detective's Phoenix. Dragon's Rage Channeler helps dig deeper into the deck while providing a solid body on the board. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with aggressive creatures and burn spells like Lightning Bolt, while maintaining card advantage and graveyard synergy. The archetype excels at overwhelming opponents with fast, explosive plays and leveraging the graveyard as a resource.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to create a powerful combo that allows for repeated milling and casting of spells from the graveyard. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and generate enough mana to go off in a single turn, ultimately winning the game by either decking the opponent or casting Thassa's Oracle with a nearly empty library. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal provide additional card advantage and ramp to facilitate the combo.

The deck focuses on comboing off quickly using mana rituals and card draw to generate enough resources to cast Past in Flames and continue the combo until victory. It utilizes cards like Ruby Medallion and Ral, Monsoon Mage to reduce costs and generate value. The goal is to find the key pieces like Desperate Ritual and Glimpse the Impossible while utilizing the storm mechanic to cast multiple spells in a turn. The deck hopes to chain together enough spells to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of disruptive counter spells and artifacts to quickly assemble the Goblin Charbelcher combo win condition. By utilizing cards like Disrupting Shoal and Whir of Invention to control the game and search for key pieces like Lotus Bloom and Thundertrap Trainer, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game without needing to rely on traditional lands. With a focus on disrupting opponents and accelerating its own win condition, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with its powerful combo potential.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, utilizing powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer to overwhelm opponents. It also includes disruptive elements such as Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board. The deck aims to maintain pressure on opponents with a mix of direct damage spells and resilient creatures, while also having some control elements to disrupt opposing strategies. By combining aggression with disruption, this deck aims to quickly outpace and defeat opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main goal of this Eldrazi Ramp control deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans, while also disrupting the opponent's board with removal spells like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to stabilize the game with powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with its huge threats. By combining ramp, control, and massive Eldrazi creatures, this deck aims to outvalue and outpace its opponent in the late game to secure the win.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board state. The deck includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory to boost the power of your creatures and push for more damage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and relentless assault, while maintaining some control over the game with removal spells and disruption.
